data/action_fx.json._comment: Particles on any action of any body (scripts/fx/action_fx.gd). bodies.<elian | enemy id>.<trigger>: a list of emitters. A trigger is an animation the body plays (idle, run, attack, hurt…) — an emitter fires at its start (when "start"), on some of its frames (when "frames", frames: [i…]) or every `every` seconds while it plays (when "every") — or an event the game names: step (a footfall), jump, land, roll, wake. An emitter: fx dust | puff | sparkle | ash | debris | ring | flash; at feet | body | head | hand | back, offset [x, y] (x turns with the body); dir [x, y] for dust; count; color #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; size (puff scale, sparkle width, ash spread, ring and flash radius); rise (ash); chance 0..1. Edited in the art studio, tab «Частицы».

data/ambience.json._comment: Which living details a room gets, by a substring of its scene name (first match wins). Effects: ravens, bats, leaves, petals, wisps, motes, embers, low_fog, lightning, clouds. See scripts/rooms/ambience.gd.

data/backdrops.json._comment: The life of each painted backdrop: scripts/rooms/backdrop_life.gd, docs/BACKDROP_LIFE.md. A family sets how painted flames burn (flame: flicker strength; flame_floor: how bright a warm pixel must be to count as a flame — raise it where whole walls glow). A room may override both and lists zones in painting pixels (the texture the room draws, wide panels included): kind falls | water (floor: how bright its lit water is — darker pixels, posts and reeds, keep still) | sway (anchor hangs/stands; strength = pixels) | glow (tint) | lava | haze | stars | pulse; strength and speed are optional.

data/gore.json._comment: Blood and torn limbs (scripts/fx/gore.gd). materials.<material from data/enemies>: what a body of that stuff bleeds; bodies.<elian | enemy id>: keys laid over its material's. Keys: blood #rrggbb(aa) — the colour; shade — how far each drop and mark strays darker or lighter from it (0..0.5); drops — drops a blow throws (more for a crit, a backstab, a heavy blow); spray — how fast they fly, px/s; stain — how big the marks they leave are (0 = they leave none); stain_life — seconds a mark stays before it fades; gush — drops a death throws; pool — how wide the pool under a body grows, px (0 = none); bleed — seconds a wound keeps dripping; spurt — seconds a stump jets in pulses after a tear (0 = it only drips); limbs — pieces the body tears into on death, cut from its own drawing (0 = it never does; 2 upper/lower, 3 head/torso/legs, 4 + two legs, 5–6 + arms); chance — how often a death tears it apart (a crit or a backstab doubles it); fling — how hard the pieces fly, px/s; cuts — how a tear goes, by weight: all (to pieces), head (the head off), half (at the waist), limb (an arm off; a body of 4 or fewer pieces has none and loses its head) — what is left stands a beat, then topples. Cut lines are ragged, every death different. Where it lands: mist — faint specks a blow throws that leave no mark; soak — how much of a mark sinks into the painting under it rather than lying on top (0..1, a multiply pass); splash — droplets a heavy drop throws back up off a floor; run — px a streak runs down a wall (never past the wall's foot; less of it on the painting behind); drip — how readily what reaches over a ledge's edge or sticks under it drips off (0..1); back — the share of drops that fly into the depth and stick to the painted wall behind (never in the sky or a far opening). A mark stops at the edge of what it lies on. Settings → Blood: full, reduced (half the drops, no limbs), off. Edited in the art studio, tab «Кровь».

data/music/playlists.json._comment: generated by tools/audio/fetch_music.py; a room's `music` name is looked up here first

data/projectiles.json._comment: How every bolt looks in flight (scripts/fx/projectile.gd). sheet: a strip of `frames` frames played at `fps`. scale; light: glow radius; trail: trail particles; shader: the flight shader motion_kind (0 blade, 1 holy, 2 dark, 3 ember, 4 wheel). Animation, all optional: pulse (size breathes, 17/s), breathe [amount, speed], squash [base, amount, speed] (height only), bob [px, speed], wiggle [radians, speed], spin (radians/s). echo: the fainter copy behind it — offset px back, sway [px, speed], scale, spin, color, alpha. burst: what is left where it dies — fx sparkle | ash | debris | spark with color, count (spread, size). Edited in the art studio, tab «Снаряды».
